name: BPW Maude Spielvogel Scholarship (SCU Coffs Harbour)
summary: $1,500 for a female Coffs Harbour campus student, second year or later, who is facing hardship or another challenge.
who: Enrolled in the second year or later of on-campus studies in Coffs Harbour.
Live between Grafton and Nambucca and west to Dorrigo.
Facing a challenge such as financial hardship, family trauma, medical concerns, single parenthood or disability.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with a 150 to 250 word personal statement.
